enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Fall asleep. Remain asleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Breathe steadily. Remain asleep. Turn again. Adjust blanket. Continue sleeping.
Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Stretch arms overhead. Yawn. Rub eyes. Swing legs over edge of bed. Stand up. Stretch back. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink. Open dishwasher. Place bowl in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table. Exit kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Apply deodorant. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check schedule. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk to building. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at hospital. Put on scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Check patient charts. Visit patient rooms. Take vital signs. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with doctors. Assist with procedures. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to duties. Attend afternoon meeting. Review test results. Communicate with patients. Complete paperwork. End shift. Remove scrubs. Leave workplace.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Greet family. Remove shoes. Hang up coat.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot and pan. Turn on stove. Add oil. Chop vegetables. Add to pan. Stir. Add chicken. Cook. Turn off stove. Plate food. Sit and eat. Clear table. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Wipe counter.

Enter living room. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Flip through channels. Select program. Watch. Adjust volume. Lean back. Watch. Check phone. Put phone down. Watch. Change channel. Watch. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Type password. Open browser. Check email. Reply to email. Open document. Type report. Save file. Open social media. Browse. Scroll. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Close game. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up.

Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select movie. Watch. Adjust volume. Lean back. Put feet up. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Drink water. Watch. Change channel. Watch. Check phone. Put phone down. Watch. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Brush teeth. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Exit bathroom.
Enter bedroom. Turn on lamp. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Remain still. Fall asleep. Shift position. Adjust blanket. Breathe deeply. Remain asleep. Turn again. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.
